# KG subscriptions

A **substrate** is an external Knowledge Graph: a repository whose root declaration meets bootstrap's schema requirements and declares at least one harness. An instance **subscribes** to one at a pinned commit, then chooses which of its subgraphs, assets and harnesses to hold. Everything it does not choose stays **referenced**: known, and not copied. Design: the [KG subscriptions proposal]({{ '/proposals/kg-subscriptions.html' | relative_url }}) (issue #1719).

## Known substrates

Derived from the declarations wherever a fact exists: a staged instance's planned repository, and an associated harness's site. Only what no declaration can say is hand-entered, in `knownSubstrates`.

_No instance subscribes to a substrate yet._ The first planned subscription is `litlfred/ihris`, which is already associated (epic bean `fnx4`).
